findings.identity_explanation: Tag FP-03 matches exactly in CR:FP-03, ES:FP-03, FM:TFM-0203, COM-06 line 13 and WAR-07 line 11. Model RF-DS150, serial RFD-15033 and location Basement 1 fire pump room agree across the sources, with no conflicts.

exceptions.finding: No O&M manual lists FP-03 in its Covers line. OM-05 only says a separate engine supplier manual is to be issued. A promise that a document will follow is not the document (Evidence 2.3). FP-03 is a life-safety asset (diesel standby fire pump), so this open exception makes it Not ready for acceptance (Readiness 3.1).

evidence.quote: The diesel fire pump FP-03 is covered by a separate manual from the engine supplier, to be issued.

exceptions.responsible_party: Installing subcontractor (Embral Fire Systems), through Halvorn Contracting
exceptions.next_action: Request the engine supplier O&M manual for FP-03, with a Covers line listing FP-03, before the 24 November 2026 handover.

findings.summary: FP-03 is identified consistently in all sources, and its FM record, commissioning (Pass, Signed), warranty (expires 2028-09-29) and PPM plan all pass. The only open exception is the missing O&M manual, which is only promised as 'to be issued'. Because FP-03 is a life-safety fire pump, the rule-based status Not ready for acceptance stands and the case is escalated.
findings.escalate_to: FM handover manager (consult FM operations manager on life-safety asset)
findings.escalation_reason: Escalation 2.1: life-safety asset (diesel standby fire pump) has an open exception (missing O&M manual). The FM handover manager decides whether to send the clarification request; the FM operations manager is consulted before any acceptance (Escalation 1.2).
findings.clarification_subject: FP-03 diesel standby fire pump: O&M manual required before handover
findings.clarification_body: Dear Project Manager, for asset FP-03 (Diesel standby fire pump, Basement 1 fire pump room, model RF-DS150, serial RFD-15033), no issued O&M manual lists FP-03 in its Covers line. OM-05 states that FP-03 is covered by a separate engine supplier manual 'to be issued'. Please ask the installing subcontractor to provide this manual, with FP-03 listed in the Covers line, ahead of the planned handover on 24 November 2026. Thank you.
uncertainties: Whether the engine supplier manual has been issued elsewhere is unknown; none was found in the handover documents.
